changelog: Copilot Membership Tier & Model Policy Detection: Queries copilot_internal/user to detect subscription tier (Pro, Free, Business, Enterprise) and inspects model policies/endpoints from api.githubcopilot.com/models, filtering out disabled models (e.g. claude-sonnet-5) and highlighting free/included models without extra charges

Bulletproof SSE Streaming & R8 Keep Rules: Added ProGuard rules for Copilot serialization classes and implemented robust dual-layer SSE parsing with token fallback regex so streaming tokens are never swallowed or lost in release builds
Integrated Copilot in Accounts Bar & Switcher: Added GitHub Copilot to the bottom-bar accounts pill alongside AG and Claude, and integrated Copilot account details into the Accounts modal dialog
Collapsible Subscription Spaces: Added interactive expand/collapse toggles to each agent card in the Accounts dialog, reducing vertical clutter and keeping the switcher compact

Settings UI Redesign (React Bits-inspired Expandable Accordions): Redesigned the main settings screen into sleek, glassmorphic expandable category sections with quick Expand/Collapse All controls, keeping 100% of settings options cleanly organized
